pages.brief: Moss the hedgehog setting a small plant pot down in a bright sunny spot among greenhouse shelves.
Olive the owl copying Moss, setting her own plant pot down in a shady gap between shelves.
A plant pot sitting in a dim, shady gap, no sunlight reaching it.
Olive the owl looking at her pot in a shady gap, the plant drooping and unhappy.
Olive the owl carrying her pot out of a shady gap and setting it down next to another pot in the sun.
A plant in a pot now perked up and healthy, sitting bright in a sunny spot.
Olive the owl and Moss the hedgehog sitting side by side in a sunny spot, two healthy potted plants beside them.
